summary: Regression + feature test for Support Phase 2/3/4 + Legacy overhaul + Reports screen. Backend: 8/8 new tests passed (bug/privacy/delete_account/billing ticket creation with structured descriptions, admin gating, admin status patch). Frontend Playwright drove full flows on mobile viewport 390x844: login → Legacy (all 8 pills present including new 30yr, cumulative toggle works, in-app nav persistence verified via screenshot after nav-home→nav-legacy), Reports screen (all 6 window pills, INCOME/EXPENSE/NET tiles, 5 sections in correct order, proper empty states), Support hub (5 help testIDs + support-new + support-list), Bug/Privacy/Delete/Billing all submit and produce tickets with correct structured description labels, Bank Help Center renders both tip cards + full guide list (Chase, BofA, Wells Fargo…) + open-ticket CTA. Delete-submit is correctly disabled (opacity 0.6, aria-disabled=true) until user types DELETE (opacity 1). billing-open-web link banner is visible. No red screens, no unhandled errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SupportSheet.tsx is now 1167 lines — approaching the 700-line splittability threshold. Consider extracting each specialized mode (BugReportMode, PrivacyMode, DeleteAccountMode, BillingMode, BankHelpMode, HubMode) into its own file under src/support/ for maintainability. Not a functional bug.

app/index.tsx is 3572 lines. It has been long but the recent lift of Legacy state to MainApp was correct — timeframe/contribution/hypothetical/cumulative are all persisted via STORAGE_KEY. Consider splitting screens into src/screens/ in a follow-up.
Delete Account submit correctly disabled (opacity 0.6, aria-disabled=true) until confirmText === 'DELETE'; verified end-to-end.
billing-open-web uses Linking.openURL which is safe; test did not actually open the URL.

Reports screen uses react-native-svg with hand-rolled pie + bar charts; on web it renders as <svg>. Empty states are handled per-section ('No expenses in this range.', 'No transactions in this range.', 'No data.', 'No expenses to analyze.') — no crashes with zero transactions.
bankGuides.ts is a clean shared module (129 lines) — good DRY extraction from index.tsx.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executable checks (all testIDs present, all specialized flows produce correctly-labeled tickets, empty states render safely)
